title: Rename Environments in the Admin Center

facts.text: Renaming changes environment URL; can impact bookmarks, deep links, integrations, mobile apps, and external services.
Environment name limited to 30 characters, must start with letter, contain only letters numbers hyphens underscores; cannot be reserved name like admin or api.
Renaming requires environment restart; recommended during times when no users are active in Business Central.
Select Environments, choose environment, select Rename, enter new name, confirm intent to rename.
Name must be unique within same application family in tenant; environment state changes to Preparing | Rename Scheduled then Active.
Old environment name becomes inaccessible immediately; rename operation logged on Operations page.
Affected areas include web client URLs, deep links to pages, Outlook Excel Power BI add-ins, external integrations, mobile apps, browser cache.
